// Secrets are NOT inlined — set before running: API_KEY, APP_PASSWORD
// Generated by Cairntrace `cairn export playwright`. Edit at your own risk —
// re-running export will overwrite. Source: /specs/flows/late.yml
// Intent: secrets/run-token stay late-bound; reload rescue; node verifier
// Lang: ts
//
// ⚠ PRECONDITIONS (NOT exported — run these before the test, e.g. in globalSetup):
//   [reset_status] mongosh --eval 'db.x.updateOne(...)'

import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

const RUN_TOKEN = process.env.CAIRN_RUN_TOKEN ?? Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10);

test("golden_late_bound", async ({ page }) => {
  process.env.CAIRN_RUN_START_FLOOR_MS = String(Date.now());

  // --- steps ---
  // step: go
  await page.goto("https://example.com/login");
  // step: fill_password
  await page.locator("input[type=password]").fill(`${process.env.APP_PASSWORD ?? ""}`);
  // step: fill_unique
  await page.locator("#site").fill(`site-${RUN_TOKEN}.example.com`);
  // step: rescue_blank
  let rescued;
  try {
    rescued = await page.evaluate(async (args) => {
      if (!document.querySelector('#card')) { location.reload(); }
      return 'ok';
    }, {});
  } catch (err) {
    if (!String(err).includes("Execution context was destroyed")) throw err;
    await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle", { timeout: 45000 });
    rescued = await page.evaluate(async (args) => {
      if (!document.querySelector('#card')) { location.reload(); }
      return 'ok';
    }, {});
  }
  // Note: later steps that splice ${evals.rescued…} are not rewritten — wire variables manually if needed.

  // --- outcomes (the contract) ---
  // durably_processed: node verifier proves durable processing
  {
    // node verifier (runs in the test's node context, not the browser)
    const mod = await import("../../verifiers/check.ts");
    // ESM/CJS interop: Playwright transpiles TS imports to CJS, so a
    // default export may surface as mod.default.default.
    const verify =
      mod.verify ??
      (typeof mod.default === "function" ? mod.default : (mod.default?.verify ?? mod.default?.default));
    expect(typeof verify, "verifier module must export verify()").toBe("function");
    const res = await verify({
      fixtures: { "expectedRoute": "temporal", "token": `prefix-${RUN_TOKEN}`, "secret": `${process.env.API_KEY ?? ""}` },
      artifacts: {},
      vars: {},
      specDir: "/specs/flows",
    });
    expect(res && res.ok, `verifier evidence: ${JSON.stringify(res && (res.evidence ?? res))}`).toBe(true);
  }

});
